title: Reactor Cooling: A Toybox Engineering Safety Model
text: Follow the 8-step modeling process as you brainstorm with your team. When you write up your final report be sure to use section headers, well developed paragraphs, well labeled graphs, clear explanations of the mathematics, etc. Unit 03 Report will be a Team Report. For this assignment (U03 Modeling Process and Collaboration Part I) turn in your brainstorming for steps 1-4 of the process.

title: Reactor Cooling: A Toybox Engineering Safety Model
text:
Polynomial:
Of form \(T(t)=c_1t^n + c_2t^{n-1} +...+c_kt^0\).
We’ll limit \(n\) and \(k\) to three or four, at most, since we don’t want to overfit.

title: Reactor Cooling: A Toybox Engineering Safety Model
text:
Exponential decay:
Of form \(T(t) = (c_2)e^{c_1t}\) (\(c_2\) is negative).
We’ll linearize this so that it can be optimized with linear programming. taking the natural log of both sides give us
\(\ln[T(t)]=c_1t+c_2\)
